FX-TONER-001.says: Tritone, the colours as they start: black, a sepia brown and white, a warm sepia print of the picture by its lightness.

FX-TONER-002.says: Duotone, as it starts: black to white, the picture turned to greys by its lightness.

FX-TONER-003.says: Pentone, as it starts: black, dark brown, sepia, cream and white, a sepia print with more steps.

FX-TONER-004.says: Tritone, navy, red and pale yellow: a night-to-sunset colouring.

FX-TONER-005.says: Duotone, deep purple to warm yellow.

FX-TONER-006.says: Pentone, five colours from near-black purple through violet and orange to pale yellow.

FX-TONER-007.says: Tritone with brights and darktones set to loud green and blue: tritone does not use them, so the same as FX-TONER-001.

FX-TONER-008.says: Duotone with midtones set to green: duotone does not use it, so the same as FX-TONER-002.

FX-TONER-009.says: FX-TONER-004 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-TONER-010.says: Tones "quadtone", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TONER-011.says: Tones "Tritone": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TONER-012.says: Highlights "#fff", which is not #rrggbb. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TONER-013.says: Midtones "brown", which is not a colour code. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
